description: Configure the LinkedIn Ad Library search. Provide keywords, advertiser names, or pre-built Ad Library URLs.

advertisers.description: Advertiser / company names to search (e.g., 'Microsoft', 'Salesforce'). LinkedIn matches the advertiser display name.
advertisers.title: Advertisers

countries.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'IN'). Filters ads to those served in the selected countries.
countries.title: Countries

dateFrom.description: Start date for custom range (YYYY-MM-DD). Only used when dateOption=custom.
dateFrom.title: Date From

dateOption.description: Pre-defined date window. Use 'custom' to specify exact dateFrom/dateTo.
dateOption.title: Date Range

dateTo.description: End date for custom range (YYYY-MM-DD). Only used when dateOption=custom.
dateTo.title: Date To

directUrls.description: Pre-built LinkedIn Ad Library URLs. Use this if you've already configured filters on linkedin.com/ad-library and just want to paste the URL.
directUrls.title: Direct URLs

enrichWithDetailPage.description: When true, fetches each ad's detail page (/ad-library/detail/{id}) to enrich records with `paid_for_by` (DSA disclosure), canonical `advertiser_url`, and any longer body copy. Adds ~0.5-1 s per ad. Note: impressions and targeting facets are loaded via XHR after render and are NOT extractable without a full browser session, so they remain unavailable.
enrichWithDetailPage.title: Enrich With Detail Page

maxResults.description: Maximum number of ads to return across all queries.
maxResults.title: Maximum Results

proxy.description: Optional proxy. The LinkedIn Ad Library is fully public and works from datacenter IPs, so the default Apify Proxy is enabled but no residential group is required.
proxy.title: Proxy Configuration

searchTerms.description: Keyword search queries (e.g., 'AI', 'cloud computing'). The Ad Library matches ads whose copy or advertiser contains any of these terms.
searchTerms.title: Search Terms

title: LinkedIn Ads Scraper Input
